scope: Meybod, around 1900; modest visitor to a working ice house, no official or royal status
garments: Plain knee-length muted olive/brown outer robe over a cream collarless shirt and straight loose slate trousers; modest dark cloth waist tie; simple dark soft shoes. Long sleeves narrowed enough for ordinary work; no embroidery, metallic trim, huge sash, weapons, jewels or ceremonial headgear. Visitor's familiar hair remains visible; no change of ethnic identity or facial hair.
season_variants: Use one consistent plain closed-front or modestly overlapping robe configuration in every pose. Moderate loose fit works for the illustrative visit in both seasons; no shot-dependent open/closed variant is required.
